def sha_fallback_reference.or
  (a : Array Std.U32 4#usize) (b : Array Std.U32 4#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize b 0#usize
  let i2 ← lift (i ||| i1)
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let i4 ← Array.index_usize b 1#usize
  let i5 ← lift (i3 ||| i4)
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize b 2#usize
  let i8 ← lift (i6 ||| i7)
  let i9 ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let i10 ← Array.index_usize b 3#usize
  let i11 ← lift (i9 ||| i10)
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ i2, i5, i8, i11 ])

def sha_fallback_reference.xor
  (a : Array Std.U32 4#usize) (b : Array Std.U32 4#usize) :

def sha_fallback_reference.sha256msg1.sigma0x4
  (x : Array Std.U32 4#usize) : Result (Array Std.U32 4#usize) := do

  let a1 ← sha_fallback_reference.shr x 25#u32
  let t1 ← sha_fallback_reference.or a a1
  let a2 ← sha_fallback_reference.shl x 18#u32
  let a3 ← sha_fallback_reference.shr x 14#u32
  let t2 ← sha_fallback_reference.or a2 a3
  let t3 ← sha_fallback_reference.shl x 3#u32
  let a4 ← sha_fallback_reference.xor t1 t2
  sha_fallback_reference.xor a4 t3

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_fallback_reference::schedule]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 288:0-293:1 -/
def sha_fallback_reference.schedule
  (v0 : Array Std.U32 4#usize) (v1 : Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  (v2 : Array Std.U32 4#usize) (v3 : Array Std.U32 4#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  := do
  let t1 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256msg1 v0 v1
  let t2 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256load v2 v3
  let t3 ← sha_fallback_reference.add t1 t2
  sha_fallback_reference.sha256msg2 t3 v3

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_fallback_reference::sha256_digest_block_u32]:

def sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_block_u32
  (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (block : Array Std.U32 16#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize state 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize state 1#usize
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize state 4#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize state 5#usize
  let i4 ← Array.index_usize state 2#usize
  let i5 ← Array.index_usize state 3#usize
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize state 6#usize
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize state 7#usize
  let i8 ← Array.index_usize block 3#usize
  let i9 ← Array.index_usize block 2#usize
  let i10 ← Array.index_usize block 1#usize
  let i11 ← Array.index_usize block 0#usize
  let i12 ← Array.index_usize block 7#usize
  let i13 ← Array.index_usize block 6#usize
  let i14 ← Array.index_usize block 5#usize
  let i15 ← Array.index_usize block 4#usize
  let i16 ← Array.index_usize block 11#usize
  let i17 ← Array.index_usize block 10#usize
  let i18 ← Array.index_usize block 9#usize
  let i19 ← Array.index_usize block 8#usize
  let i20 ← Array.index_usize block 15#usize
  let i21 ← Array.index_usize block 14#usize
  let i22 ← Array.index_usize block 13#usize
  let i23 ← Array.index_usize block 12#usize
  let a ← sha_fallback_consts.K32X4
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let t1 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.add (Array.make 4#usize [ i8, i9, i10, i11 ]) a1
  let cdgh ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i4, i5, i6, i7 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i, i1, i2, i3 ]) t1
  let t2 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t1
  let abef ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i, i1, i2, i3 ]) cdgh t2
  let a2 ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let t11 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.add (Array.make 4#usize [ i12, i13, i14, i15 ]) a2
  let cdgh1 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh abef t11
  let t21 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t11
  let abef1 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef cdgh1 t21
  let a3 ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let t12 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.add (Array.make 4#usize [ i16, i17, i18, i19 ]) a3
  let cdgh2 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh1 abef1 t12
  let t22 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t12
  let abef2 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef1 cdgh2 t22
  let a4 ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let t13 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.add (Array.make 4#usize [ i20, i21, i22, i23 ]) a4
  let cdgh3 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh2 abef2 t13
  let t23 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t13
  let abef3 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef2 cdgh3 t23
  let w4 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.schedule (Array.make 4#usize [ i8, i9, i10, i11 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i12, i13, i14, i15 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i16, i17, i18, i19 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i20, i21, i22, i23 ])
  let a5 ← Array.index_usize a 4#usize
  let t14 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w4 a5
  let cdgh4 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh3 abef3 t14
  let t24 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t14
  let abef4 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef3 cdgh4 t24
  let w0 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.schedule (Array.make 4#usize [ i12, i13, i14, i15 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i16, i17, i18, i19 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i20, i21, i22, i23 ]) w4
  let a6 ← Array.index_usize a 5#usize
  let t15 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w0 a6
  let cdgh5 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh4 abef4 t15
  let t25 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t15
  let abef5 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef4 cdgh5 t25
  let w1 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.schedule (Array.make 4#usize [ i16, i17, i18, i19 ])
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i20, i21, i22, i23 ]) w4 w0
  let a7 ← Array.index_usize a 6#usize
  let t16 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w1 a7
  let cdgh6 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh5 abef5 t16
  let t26 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t16
  let abef6 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef5 cdgh6 t26
  let w2 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.schedule (Array.make 4#usize [ i20, i21, i22, i23 ])
      w4 w0 w1
  let a8 ← Array.index_usize a 7#usize
  let t17 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w2 a8
  let cdgh7 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh6 abef6 t17
  let t27 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t17
  let abef7 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef6 cdgh7 t27
  let w3 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w4 w0 w1 w2
  let a9 ← Array.index_usize a 8#usize
  let t18 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w3 a9
  let cdgh8 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh7 abef7 t18
  let t28 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t18
  let abef8 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef7 cdgh8 t28
  let w41 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w0 w1 w2 w3
  let a10 ← Array.index_usize a 9#usize
  let t19 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w41 a10
  let cdgh9 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh8 abef8 t19
  let t29 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t19
  let abef9 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef8 cdgh9 t29
  let w01 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w1 w2 w3 w41
  let a11 ← Array.index_usize a 10#usize
  let t110 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w01 a11
  let cdgh10 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh9 abef9 t110
  let t210 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t110
  let abef10 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef9 cdgh10 t210
  let w11 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w2 w3 w41 w01
  let a12 ← Array.index_usize a 11#usize
  let t111 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w11 a12
  let cdgh11 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh10 abef10 t111
  let t211 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t111
  let abef11 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef10 cdgh11 t211
  let w21 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w3 w41 w01 w11
  let a13 ← Array.index_usize a 12#usize
  let t112 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w21 a13
  let cdgh12 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh11 abef11 t112
  let t212 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t112
  let abef12 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef11 cdgh12 t212
  let w31 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w41 w01 w11 w21
  let a14 ← Array.index_usize a 13#usize
  let t113 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w31 a14
  let cdgh13 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh12 abef12 t113
  let t213 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t113
  let abef13 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef12 cdgh13 t213
  let w42 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w01 w11 w21 w31
  let a15 ← Array.index_usize a 14#usize
  let t114 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w42 a15
  let cdgh14 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh13 abef13 t114
  let t214 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t114
  let abef14 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef13 cdgh14 t214
  let w02 ← sha_fallback_reference.schedule w11 w21 w31 w42
  let a16 ← Array.index_usize a 15#usize
  let t115 ← sha_fallback_reference.add w02 a16
  let cdgh15 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 cdgh14 abef14 t115
  let t215 ← sha_fallback_reference.sha256swap t115
  let abef15 ←
    sha_fallback_reference.sha256_digest_round_x2 abef14 cdgh15 t215
  let a17 ← Array.index_usize abef15 0#usize
  let b ← Array.index_usize abef15 1#usize
  let e ← Array.index_usize abef15 2#usize
  let f ← Array.index_usize abef15 3#usize
  let c ← Array.index_usize cdgh15 0#usize
  let d ← Array.index_usize cdgh15 1#usize
  let g ← Array.index_usize cdgh15 2#usize
  let h ← Array.index_usize cdgh15 3#usize
  let i24 ← lift (core.num.U32.wrapping_add i a17)
  let state1 ← Array.update state 0#usize i24
  let i25 ← Array.index_usize state1 1#usize
  let i26 ← lift (core.num.U32.wrapping_add i25 b)
  let state2 ← Array.update state1 1#usize i26
  let i27 ← Array.index_usize state2 2#usize
  let i28 ← lift (core.num.U32.wrapping_add i27 c)
  let state3 ← Array.update state2 2#usize i28
  let i29 ← Array.index_usize state3 3#usize
  let i30 ← lift (core.num.U32.wrapping_add i29 d)
  let state4 ← Array.update state3 3#usize i30

  let state5 ← Array.update state4 4#usize i32

  let i34 ← lift (core.num.U32.wrapping_add i33 f)

  let state7 ← Array.update state6 6#usize i36
  let i37 ← Array.index_usize state7 7#usize
  let i38 ← lift (core.num.U32.wrapping_add i37 h)
  Array.update state7 7#usize i38

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_pad_zero]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 423:4-423:34
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sha_pad_zero_loop.body
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U8 64#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U8
    64#usize))
  := do
  if i < 64#usize
  then
    let buffer1 ← Array.update buffer i 0#u8
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (buffer1, i1))
  else ok (done buffer)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_pad_zero]: loop 0:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 423:4-423:34
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def sha_pad_zero_loop
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U8 64#usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (buffer1, i1) => sha_pad_zero_loop.body buffer1 i1)
    (buffer, i)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_pad_zero]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 420:0-425:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_pad_zero
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (pos : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U8 64#usize)
  := do
  let buffer1 ← Array.update buffer pos 128#u8
  let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add pos 1#usize)
  sha_pad_zero_loop buffer1 i

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_pad_suffix8]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 443:0-448:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_pad_suffix8
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (suffix : Array Std.U8 8#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U8 64#usize)
  := do
  let a ← Array.index_usize suffix 0#usize
  let b ← Array.index_usize suffix 1#usize
  let c ← Array.index_usize suffix 2#usize
  let d ← Array.index_usize suffix 3#usize
  let e ← Array.index_usize suffix 4#usize
  let f ← Array.index_usize suffix 5#usize
  let g ← Array.index_usize suffix 6#usize
  let h ← Array.index_usize suffix 7#usize
  let buffer1 ← Array.update buffer 56#usize a
  let buffer2 ← Array.update buffer1 57#usize b
  let buffer3 ← Array.update buffer2 58#usize c
  let buffer4 ← Array.update buffer3 59#usize d
  let buffer5 ← Array.update buffer4 60#usize e
  let buffer6 ← Array.update buffer5 61#usize f
  let buffer7 ← Array.update buffer6 62#usize g
  Array.update buffer7 63#usize h

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_pad_owned_split8]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 449:0-459:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_pad_owned_split8
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (pos : Std.Usize)
  (suffix : Array Std.U8 8#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U8 64#usize) × (Option (Array Std.U8 64#usize)) × (Array
    Std.U8 64#usize) × Std.Usize)
  := do
  let head ← sha_pad_zero buffer pos
  let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub 64#usize pos)
  let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize)
  if i1 < 8#usize
  then
    let a := Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8
    let second ← sha_pad_suffix8 a suffix
    ok (head, some second, head, 0#usize)
  else
    let first ← sha_pad_suffix8 head suffix
    ok (first, none, first, 0#usize)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_load_be4]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 462:0-464:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_load_be4 (b : Array Std.U8 4#usize) : Result Std.U32 := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize b 0#usize
  let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i)
  let i2 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shl i1 24#u32)
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize b 1#usize
  let i4 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i3)
  let i5 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shl i4 16#u32)
  let i6 ← lift (i2 ||| i5)
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize b 2#usize
  let i8 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i7)
  let i9 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shl i8 8#u32)
  let i10 ← lift (i6 ||| i9)
  let i11 ← Array.index_usize b 3#usize
  let i12 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i11)
  ok (i10 ||| i12)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_store_be4]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 465:0-467:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_store_be4 (w : Std.U32) : Result (Array Std.U8 4#usize) := do
  let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shr w 24#u32)
  let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i)
  let i2 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shr w 16#u32)
  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i2)
  let i4 ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_shr w 8#u32)
  let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i4)
  let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 w)
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i6 ])

  sha_load_be4 (Array.make 4#usize [ i, i1, i2, i3 ])

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_load64]:

    Visibility: public -/
def sha_load64
  (b : Array Std.U8 64#usize) : Result (Array Std.U32 16#usize) := do
  let i ← sha_load_lane0 b
  let i1 ← sha_load_lane1 b
  let i2 ← sha_load_lane2 b
  let i3 ← sha_load_lane3 b
  let i4 ← sha_load_lane4 b
  let i5 ← sha_load_lane5 b
  let i6 ← sha_load_lane6 b
  let i7 ← sha_load_lane7 b
  let i8 ← sha_load_lane8 b
  let i9 ← sha_load_lane9 b
  let i10 ← sha_load_lane10 b
  let i11 ← sha_load_lane11 b
  let i12 ← sha_load_lane12 b
  let i13 ← sha_load_lane13 b
  let i14 ← sha_load_lane14 b
  let i15 ← sha_load_lane15 b
  ok
    (Array.make 16#usize [
      i, i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, i6, i7, i8, i9, i10, i11, i12, i13, i14, i15
      ])

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_length_suffix64]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 503:0-506:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_length_suffix64 (w : Std.U64) : Result (Array Std.U8 8#usize) := do
  let i ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 56#u32)
  let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i)
  let i2 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 48#u32)
  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i2)
  let i4 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 40#u32)
  let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i4)
  let i6 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 32#u32)
  let i7 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i6)
  let i8 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 24#u32)
  let i9 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i8)
  let i10 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 16#u32)
  let i11 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i10)
  let i12 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr w 8#u32)
  let i13 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i12)
  let i14 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 w)
  ok (Array.make 8#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i7, i9, i11, i13, i14 ])

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_compress_byte_owned]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 507:0-509:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_compress_byte_owned
  (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (block : Array Std.U8 64#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  := do
  let a ← sha_load64 block
  sha_fallback_reference.extracted_block state a

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_digest32]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 510:0-517:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_digest32
  (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) : Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize) := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize state 0#usize
  let a ← sha_store_be4 i
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize state 1#usize
  let b ← sha_store_be4 i1
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize state 2#usize
  let c ← sha_store_be4 i2
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize state 3#usize
  let d ← sha_store_be4 i3
  let i4 ← Array.index_usize state 4#usize
  let e ← sha_store_be4 i4
  let i5 ← Array.index_usize state 5#usize
  let f ← sha_store_be4 i5
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize state 6#usize
  let g ← sha_store_be4 i6
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize state 7#usize
  let h ← sha_store_be4 i7
  let i8 ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let i9 ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let i10 ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let i11 ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let i12 ← Array.index_usize b 0#usize
  let i13 ← Array.index_usize b 1#usize
  let i14 ← Array.index_usize b 2#usize
  let i15 ← Array.index_usize b 3#usize
  let i16 ← Array.index_usize c 0#usize
  let i17 ← Array.index_usize c 1#usize
  let i18 ← Array.index_usize c 2#usize
  let i19 ← Array.index_usize c 3#usize
  let i20 ← Array.index_usize d 0#usize
  let i21 ← Array.index_usize d 1#usize
  let i22 ← Array.index_usize d 2#usize
  let i23 ← Array.index_usize d 3#usize
  let i24 ← Array.index_usize e 0#usize
  let i25 ← Array.index_usize e 1#usize
  let i26 ← Array.index_usize e 2#usize
  let i27 ← Array.index_usize e 3#usize
  let i28 ← Array.index_usize f 0#usize
  let i29 ← Array.index_usize f 1#usize
  let i30 ← Array.index_usize f 2#usize
  let i31 ← Array.index_usize f 3#usize
  let i32 ← Array.index_usize g 0#usize
  let i33 ← Array.index_usize g 1#usize
  let i34 ← Array.index_usize g 2#usize
  let i35 ← Array.index_usize g 3#usize
  let i36 ← Array.index_usize h 0#usize
  let i37 ← Array.index_usize h 1#usize
  let i38 ← Array.index_usize h 2#usize
  let i39 ← Array.index_usize h 3#usize
  ok
    (Array.make 32#usize [
      i8, i9, i10, i11, i12, i13, i14, i15, i16, i17, i18, i19, i20, i21, i22,
      i23, i24, i25, i26, i27, i28, i29, i30, i31, i32, i33, i34, i35, i36,
      i37, i38, i39
      ])

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_finalize_soft_owned]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 518:0-525:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_finalize_soft_owned
  (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (blocks : Std.U64)
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (pos : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U8 32#usize) × (Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U8
    64#usize) × Std.Usize)
  := do
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 pos)
  let i1 ← lift (core.num.U64.wrapping_mul 64#u64 blocks)
  let i2 ← lift (core.num.U64.wrapping_add i i1)
  let bits ← lift (core.num.U64.wrapping_mul 8#u64 i2)
  let a ← sha_length_suffix64 bits
  let (first, second, retained, newpos) ← sha_pad_owned_split8 buffer pos a
  let next ← sha_compress_byte_owned state first
  let next1 ←
    match second with
    | none => ok next
    | some block => sha_compress_byte_owned next block
  let a1 ← sha_digest32 next1
  ok (a1, next1, retained, newpos)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_update_soft_owned]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 531:4-534:5
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sha_update_soft_owned_loop.body
  (data : Slice Std.U8) (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (blocks : Std.U64)
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (pos : Std.Usize) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × (Array Std.U8
    64#usize) × Std.Usize × Std.Usize) ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 ×
    (Array Std.U8 64#usize) × Std.Usize))
  := do
  let i1 := Slice.len data
  if i < i1
  then
    let i2 ← Slice.index_usize data i
    let (_, index_mut_back) ← Array.index_mut_usize buffer pos
    let pos1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add pos 1#usize)
    let i3 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    if pos1 = 64#usize
    then
      let buffer1 := index_mut_back i2
      let state1 ← sha_compress_byte_owned state buffer1
      let blocks1 ← lift (core.num.U64.wrapping_add blocks 1#u64)
      ok (cont (state1, blocks1, buffer1, 0#usize, i3))
    else
      let buffer1 := index_mut_back i2
      ok (cont (state, blocks, buffer1, pos1, i3))
  else ok (done (state, blocks, buffer, pos))

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_update_soft_owned]: loop 0:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 531:4-534:5
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def sha_update_soft_owned_loop
  (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (blocks : Std.U64)
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (pos : Std.Usize) (data : Slice Std.U8)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × (Array Std.U8 64#usize) ×
    Std.Usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (state1, blocks1, buffer1, pos1, i1) =>
      sha_update_soft_owned_loop.body data state1 blocks1 buffer1 pos1 i1)
    (state, blocks, buffer, pos, i)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_update_soft_owned]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 528:0-536:1
    Visibility: public -/
@[reducible]
def sha_update_soft_owned
  (state : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (blocks : Std.U64)
  (buffer : Array Std.U8 64#usize) (pos : Std.Usize) (data : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × (Array Std.U8 64#usize) ×
    Std.Usize)
  := do
  sha_update_soft_owned_loop state blocks buffer pos data 0#usize

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_default_soft_owned]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 537:0-539:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_default_soft_owned
  :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × (Array Std.U8 64#usize) ×
    Std.Usize)
  := do
  let a := Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8
  ok
    (Array.make 8#usize [
       1779033703#u32, 3144134277#u32, 1013904242#u32, 2773480762#u32,
       1359893119#u32, 2600822924#u32, 528734635#u32, 1541459225#u32
       ], 0#u64, a, 0#usize)

/-- [pv_cblib_source::sha_digest_soft_owned]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 540:0-545:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sha_digest_soft_owned
  (data : Slice Std.U8) : Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize) := do
  let (state, blocks, buffer, pos) ← sha_default_soft_owned
  let (state1, blocks1, buffer1, pos1) ←
    sha_update_soft_owned state blocks buffer pos data
  let (digest, _, _, _) ← sha_finalize_soft_owned state1 blocks1 buffer1 pos1
  ok digest

end PV_CBL_DigestSoft
